messages:
Anna: Quick ask — compiling inputs from HW partners for the marketplace cost model. Need: lead times, min commit (GPU-hours or nodes), spot eviction pattern (p50/p95), listing fee structure, invoice cadence/settlement, cancellation/early-termination fees, burst availability, and any marketplace surcharge. Can partners fill a single CSV or paste values here? cc: @devin @sam

Devin: +1. For finance we need: currency, MSRP per-hour, committed rate tiers, billing cycle (monthly/quarterly), PO vs marketplace billing. Ideally sample invoice lines or a CSV.

Sam: For ops: eviction distro over last 90d (histogram), typical eviction notice (secs/mins), preemptible reclaim patterns (time-of-day), and whether there are separate spot pools per region. If they can export `eviction_rates.csv` that helps.

Leo: Also include per-SKU burst lanes (max concurrent nodes), ramp-up lead time (days), and soft-reserve window (hours). If partner offers flexible commit conversion (spot->reserved), note conversion fee.

Nina: Legal: include termination notice requirement, refunds on unused reserved, dispute resolution & SLA credits. We need exact clause text or reference.

Anna: Suggested template (paste CSV row):
```
partner,sku,region,commit_min_hours,commit_term_months,reserved_price_usd_hr,spot_price_usd_hr,spot_eviction_p50_sec,spot_eviction_p95_sec,listing_fee_pct,invoice_terms,early_termination_fee_usd,burst_capacity_nodes,lead_time_days,publicity_ok
```
Can partners populate that.

Devin: I'll wire this into the cost model mapping. If they can't share full histograms, p50/p95 for eviction and a stddev for price is enough.

marketplace-bot: action created: partnerships/MP-234 add partner inputs — assigned anna, due 3 days

Sam: small ask — include historical price variance (stddev) if available; helps Monte Carlo sim.

Anna: Good call. Also flag any embargo or co-announcement constraints — we need to sync PR windows with comms.

Anna: FYI partner replied via email: "We'll compile a draft CSV by EOD Friday. Our min commit is 1000 GPU-hours/month, 6mo term; early termination = pro-rata refund + 10% admin fee. Listing fee 3% marketplace fee. Eviction p95 ~ 11min; p50 ~ 2min. Invoices net-30 in USD. Lead time for bulk shipments ~ 14 days."

Devin: Perfect — ask them for a sample invoice PDF and a one-line clause for termination to drop into legal.

Anna: Will do. Thanks all :pray:
